query: Turn our incident-response runbook into a skill. It has a 9-step procedure for declaring and running an incident, a postmortem template that must be followed exactly, and a 200-line appendix of paging policies per team that only matters when paging someone.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/workflows.md and reference/evaluation.md before writing the skill
Names the skill for the activity in lowercase hyphenated form (e.g. running-incidents), with no 'claude' or 'anthropic' and at most 64 characters
Writes the description in third person with what it does and a 'Use when' clause naming triggers such as declaring an incident, paging, or writing a postmortem
Keeps the 9-step procedure in SKILL.md as numbered steps, and moves the paging appendix to its own reference file linked directly from SKILL.md with the task that needs it
Gives the postmortem template under 'ALWAYS use this exact structure', and adds a validate-fix-repeat loop to the procedure
Writes at least three evaluation scenarios as data (skills, query, files, expected_behavior), including one behavior that names the reference file that should be read
Does not explain what an incident or a postmortem is

query: Review this skill and fix it. Frontmatter: name: Claude Document Helper; description: I can help you with documents. Body: a 620-line SKILL.md that also says 'before March 2025 use the v1 API' and links to reference\forms.md, which in turn links to reference\forms-advanced.md.
expected_behavior: Renames the skill to lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens with no 'claude' and no vague word like 'helper', preferably as a gerund (e.g. processing-documents)
Rewrites the description in third person, says what the skill does, and adds a 'Use when' clause with trigger words such as file types and phrasings
Splits the 620-line body so SKILL.md is under 500 lines, moving area-specific material into files named for their content
Links forms-advanced.md directly from SKILL.md instead of only through forms.md, and each link says which task reads that file
Changes backslashes in paths to forward slashes
Moves the dated v1 API instruction into a collapsed 'Old patterns' section and describes the current method in the main text
Ends by reviewing the result against the 'Before finishing' checklist and says which items were fixed

query: Add a script to my pdf-forms skill that checks a fields.json file against the form's real field names before we fill it in.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/scripts.md before writing the script
Handles expected failures itself: a missing or unreadable fields.json and invalid JSON each print what failed and what to do next, instead of crashing
Validator errors name the bad value and list the valid ones, e.g. "Field 'signature_date' not found. Available fields: ..."
Every constant (timeouts, limits) has a comment justifying its value
SKILL.md says to run the script, gives the exact command and arguments, and describes the output format
Names every package the script needs with its install command, or uses only the standard library
Uses forward slashes and paths relative to the skill directory

query: Write an AGENTS.md for this Python package so coding agents know how to work in it.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/rules-files.md before writing
Gives exact copy-paste commands for the full test run and for running one test by name, taken from the repo rather than guessed
Groups boundaries as always, ask first, and never, with a reason for any rule that isn't obvious
Leaves out general advice the model already follows and anything a linter already enforces
Stays short: no restated README content or language tutorials
